paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: Comparison of correlation between training loss (cross-entropy objective loss for Consistency-CE and Bi-objective loss for Consistency-Bi) and translation quality (BLEU score) on train subset of WMT15 De-En task for wait-k policy.
model_annotation: The plot compares the correlation between training loss and translation quality (measured by BLEU score) for two consistency-based methods—Consistency-CE and Consistency-Bi—across different values of testing $k$ in the wait-k policy on the train subset of the WMT15 De-En task. The x-axis, labeled "testing k", ranges from 1 to 9 with integer tick marks, using a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled "Correlation", ranges from 0.5 to 0.95, also on a linear scale, with tick marks at 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, and 0.9. The orange line with square markers represents Consistency-Bi, which shows a consistently high correlation, starting at approximately 0.93 at $k=1$ and remaining nearly flat around 0.93 to 0.94 across all tested $k$ values. The blue dashed line with circle markers represents Consistency-CE, which starts at approximately 0.61 at $k=1$ and increases gradually to about 0.73 at $k=9$, indicating a moderate and steadily improving correlation with increasing $k$.
